items.caption_verbatim: Figure 2: Steps for scheduling three trips in the Naı̈ve Model 3.
items.note: Naive model, three steps: step 1 places a single red trip on the diagonal, step 2 adds the green trip and forces red off a cell, step 3 adds the blue trip. Three day-by-campsite grids side by side, each with its own axes frame: a 'Day' label over the three columns, a rotated 'Campsite' label against the six rows and 'step n' printed under each block. Filled cells are red, green and blue, one colour per trip; no tick numbers and no legend, so the numbers of days and campsites are only countable from the cells.

caption.verbatim: Figure 4: One result from the density perturbation algorithm. Results in 1978 trips in 180 days with 200 campsites and no trips stopping at the same campsite. note: Ten measured regions, ten accounted: eight figure items, of which three are single-region composite panels, plus two counted tables. The paper numbers eight figures and all eight are measured; the two tables are printed numeric grids the paper never numbers (p4 vessel counts, p14 model comparison) and are recorded as table-grid with caption_source none. rules: Two measured regions are printed numeric grids the paper never numbers - the inline vessel-type counts on p4 and the 23-row model comparison on p14 - so they are recorded in the table block as table-grid with caption_source none [table.rows].

Figures 2 and 3 are three-panel day-by-campsite step diagrams with no axes, no tick numbers and no legend, so panel_count is 3 and the family is flowchart-or-schematic rather than table-as-figure [geometry.panel_count].
Figure 1 is a binned frequency histogram, not a bar chart of categories: axis titles 'Frequency' and 'Distance in Miles' [geometry.family].

Figures 5, 7 and 8 are one measured region each holding several separately titled panels - 2x2 for Figure 5, a wide panel over two smaller ones for Figures 7 and 8 - so each is a single composite-panel row with panel_count 4, 3 and 3 [geometry.panel_count] [geometry.data_labels].
Figures 4 and 6 carry printed tick numbers on both axes and no legend; Figure 6's colour key is given in the caption instead [geometry.printed_numbers] [geometry.legend].

Captions that run on into prose are cut at the named sentence: Figure 4 before 'period with 200 campsites', Figure 5 before the numbered step list, Figure 6 before 'This model can be extended', Figure 8 before '6 Analysis of Results' [caption.verbatim].
Five figures are cited in running text within one page of the exhibit: Figure 4 from p10, Figures 5 and 6 on their own page, Figure 7 on its own page and Figure 8 from p15 [mention.lead_sentence].
The p14 comparison table is used by 5.1 Model Comparison, which prints above it, so the use rule and the placement rule agree [place.section_path].
